description: This file implements the methods of the FilePath class, which manages file path manipulations such as getting components, extensions, appending components, and normalizing separators. It is part of the base namespace and references other base components.

classes.name: FilePath
classes.description: A class for manipulating and querying file path strings, including components, extensions, normalization, and appending components.

methods.name: FindDriveLetter
methods.description: Finds the position of the drive letter in a path, if present (Windows only).

methods.name: EqualDriveLetterCaseInsensitive
methods.description: Compares two paths case-insensitively for drive letter and rest of path equality (Windows only).

methods.name: IsPathAbsolute
methods.description: Determines if a given path is absolute based on platform-specific rules.

methods.name: AreAllSeparators
methods.description: Checks if a string consists solely of separator characters.

methods.name: FinalExtensionSeparatorPosition
methods.description: Finds the position of the last extension separator in a filename.

methods.name: ExtensionSeparatorPosition
methods.description: Finds the position of the extension separator, considering double extensions.

methods.name: IsEmptyOrSpecialCase
methods.description: Checks if a path is empty, '.' or '..'.
